blocks.x: Online B.Com Program - Supply Chain Management
Logistics | Procurement | Operations | Inventory Management | Global Trade

Supply Chain Management focuses on the end-to-end coordination of business processes from suppliers to customers. This elective provides comprehensive knowledge of logistics, procurement, inventory management, and global trade operations. Students learn to optimize supply chain networks, manage vendor relationships, and implement sustainable practices. The program prepares learners for careers in logistics, operations management, procurement, and supply chain consulting across manufacturing, retail, and service industries. With emphasis on digital transformation and emerging technologies, graduates are equipped to lead modern supply chain initiatives.
Transportation planning, warehouse management, distribution networks, and last-mile delivery optimization.
Vendor selection, contract negotiation, supplier relationship management, and strategic sourcing.
Stock optimization, demand forecasting, inventory control systems, and warehouse operations.
International logistics, customs procedures, trade regulations, and cross-border supply chains.
Green logistics, circular economy principles, sustainable sourcing, and environmental compliance.
Data-driven decision making, performance metrics, supply chain visibility, and predictive analytics.
